content.text: Only Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensors and setpoints are exposed for this building. Zone_F3_Z01's reported temperature has risen ~0.7°C relative to other zones from mid-2018 onward. But I cannot distinguish "local load change" from "zone sensor fault": there are no independent room-level temperature streams, no zone power, no CO2/occupancy, no VAV airflow streams in the store — only a single zone sensor reading. Without corroboration from an independent measurement inside the zone, either cause is consistent with the data.
